entities.name: Mohammed bin Faisal Al Saud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammed bin Faisal Al Saud was a Saudi prince and businessman. He was a son of King Faisal and one of the grandsons of Saudi Arabia's founder King Abdulaziz. He was one of the pioneers in the establishment of Islamic banking and Islamic insurance.
